summary: node1 is synchronized through chronyd using pool.ntp.org and remains active after restart. The existing configuration was already correct, so no rewrite was needed. A real node reboot was proven by the changed boot ID, followed by automatic service and synchronization recovery.
actions_performed: Verified chronyd is running and enabled in OpenRC's default runlevel; no competing ntpd service is enabled.
Confirmed healthy synchronization with four online sources, a selected source, and normal leap status.
Restarted node1 exactly once using its native reboot command and verified full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Synchronize the system clock with pool.ntp.org
evidence.summary: Shows the persistent pool.ntp.org directive, running chronyd service, selected NTP source, sub-millisecond correction, and Leap status Normal.
Shows chronyd enabled in the default OpenRC runlevel before reboot and automatically running, configured, and synchronized afterward.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 9ba34f2d-9361-4128-aba4-8e3e3e34d522, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 2b21cd4a-bfe5-46bb-bd3b-59e121b4ea6f, and recovered chronyd configuration and live synchronization.
